name: OpenVibe.Host
notes: Stage A operator plane only: the ovhost CLI, run by an operator on the host (validate, plan, deploy with protected-session guards, automatic rollback, status, certificate inventory, vhost rendering, config snapshots, SQLite backups). No server and no public API yet; port 4910 is reserved for the later operator API. Stages B (tenant static hosting) and C (sandboxed user code) are not started.
